scripts.db:init: node -e "const { sequelize } = require('./models/index'); sequelize.sync({ force: true }).then(() => console.log('Base de datos sincronizada'))" && node seeders/seed.js
scripts.db:reset: node -e "const { sequelize } = require('./models/index'); sequelize.sync({ force: true }).then(() => { console.log('Base de datos reseteada'); process.exit(); });"
scripts.db:update: node -e "const { sequelize } = require('./models/index'); sequelize.sync({ alter: true }).then(() => { console.log('Base de datos actualizada'); process.exit(); });"
